title: ALMA Science Verification Data: Millimeter Continuum Polarimetry of the Bright Radio Quasar 3C 286
question: What are the millimeter (1.3 mm) total intensity and linear polarization properties of the quasar 3C 286, and how do they relate to the centimeter EVPA trend and core shift?

what.value: SW component flux 31.4 mJy at 8.4 GHz

evidence.quote: The flux density of the SW component reported in (cite: Akujor1995) is 31.4 mJy at 8.4 GHz.

recipe.method: Gain solution without polarization model, qufromgain for Q/U of calibrator, KCROSS and XYf+QU for cross-hand, then polcal for D-terms with J1337-1257
Model gain calibrator I,Q,U with CLEAN and redo gains; self-cal 3C 286 with phase then amp+phase

recipe.goal: Measure core and SW intensity and polarization
recipe.method: Peak intensities from I, Q, U images; polarization bias correction for the SW component
assumptions: Absolute EVPA error 0.4 deg from 2 deg misalignment over 29 antennas

recipe.method: Gaussian fits of C1 and C2 with JMFIT; separation vs frequency; extrapolate with power law k=1 to 230 GHz; super-resolution at 13 cm
assumptions: C2 position independent of frequency and optically thin

evidence.quote: The polarization percentage of the core is 16.7$\pm$0.2%
The EVPA of the core is $38.6\pm0.4$ degrees.

answer_key.quantity: Predicted 1.3 mm core offset upstream of 2 cm core

evidence.quote: we expect the 1.3 mm radio core to be located $\sim$ 0.17 mas upstream of the 2 cm core.

not_stated_but_needed: Image size, cell size, and CLEAN iterations/threshold/masks
Which data were excluded in the first half of the observation
Fitting regions/method for core and SW flux and polarization
Details of core-shift power-law extrapolation and error propagation
Image parameters for VLBA reduction and super-resolution beam
score_reason: Public SV data and CASA guide, but imaging and flagging details missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public SV data, CASA guide recipe, numeric results (flux, polarization fraction, EVPA).
